name: tunnel-tops-west
summary: I changed the generator and rebuilt build.nbt. The parking lot is now the Presidio Parkway: a divided highway with markings and a median barrier that sweeps from the west edge into the portal cut, with planting spilling over the portal top and the cut walls. Planted cover on park ground outside the lawns and play ground went from 52% to 70%. The trees are now clumps of flat, layered, wind-swept cypress plus tall pines. The Outpost got three new climbing structures. The Cliff Walk railing is two courses high, the paths have rounded curves, and the south terraces curve with timber bench tops and grass planters. Edge heights are unchanged and check shows nothing floating.

revisions.comment:
The module sits right on the terrain and the edges blend; but as the foreground of the hero view it still reads as a generic lawn park. Fix, keeping the box, the ground heights (especially the outer 2 blocks of every edge) and every feature's position:
1. The west W band is built as a big black parking lot with white stall lines: it is the PRESIDIO PARKWAY, a divided highway (two carriageways of 3 lanes, dark asphalt, white dashed lane lines, solid edge lines, a concrete median barrier between them) descending in a cut to the WEST TUNNEL PORTAL. Remove all parking stalls. Make the portal clearly visible: a smooth light-concrete face with two dark arched/rectangular tunnel mouths, lit, with concrete retaining walls lining the cut and the park's planting spilling over the top.
2. Planting is far too sparse: almost every park surface is flat mown grass. Keep mown lawn only on THE BIG LAWN and the mown loop in Outpost Meadow; everywhere else in the park lay dense drifts of native coastal planting in irregular sweeping bands that follow the curves of the paths: tall grass and ferns, azalea and flowering azalea bushes (leaf blocks), moss blocks and moss carpet, dead bushes, sweet berry bushes, and wildflowers in colour bands (allium, cornflower, oxeye daisy, poppy, dandelion), so that 50-70% of the park's non-lawn surface is planted and reads soft grey-green, ochre and purple from above.
3. Trees are round green blobs: make them Monterey cypress and pine: dark spruce / dark oak leaves in wide, flat-topped, layered, wind-swept crowns on short thick trunks, in clumps of 3-6, plus a few tall pines.
4. THE OUTPOST needs more: around the tall timber lookout add 3-4 big log climbing structures (crisscrossed stripped logs, log piles, balance logs, a lower second lookout deck, rope nets of chains/fences), boulders of stone/tuff, sand and gravel play ground, and the 1-wide water runnel.
5. Paths: the long sweeping curved decomposed-granite paths should be 3 wide with smooth curves and lamps every 8-10 blocks; the CLIFF WALK along the north bluff needs a clear timber railing and its two jutting overlook decks with benches.
6. The OVERLOOK terraces on the high south edge: curved, stepped concrete seating terraces (3-4 steps, slabs/stairs) with timber bench tops facing north, planters of grasses between them, a broad promenade with lamps.

applied: 1 Parkway: removed every parking stall. Two carriageways in dark gray concrete (3 lanes each on the sweep) with dashed white lane lines, a solid white outer edge, a solid yellow inner edge, a polished-andesite median barrier and smooth-stone shoulders. The road sweeps on one arc from the west edge into the existing cut and portal. The rest of the old lot is now a planted verge with cypress clumps. I fixed the centre line so the 2-wide median meets the pier between the two tunnel mouths. Portal: same smooth-stone and calcite face with dark lit bores (sea lanterns, black back wall), lane lines carried inside, and azalea/flowering azalea leaf heaps spilling over the lid edge and the banks above both retaining walls.

2 Planting: added a dense planting pass in sweeping bands that bend like the paths: tall grass/ferns, purple allium/cornflower, ochre dead bush and sweet berry on coarse dirt, moss blocks and carpet, poppy/oxeye daisy/dandelion, and low azalea leaf shrubs 1-2 high. The verge, bluffs, lid and beds are covered, and there are more shrub mounds on both bluffs. Mown lawn stays only on the Big Lawn and the meadow's mown loop. Measured cover on park ground outside the lawns and play ground: 70%, up from 52% in v1. poppy and oxeye_daisy were added to palette.json; both exist in 1.21.1.

3 Trees: replaced the old trees with Monterey cypress in clumps of 3-6: short thick dark-oak trunks (2x2 where the ground allows) with a limb leaning east, and wide flat layered crowns (dark oak leaves under spruce leaves, with an upper tier pushed east). Each grove also has 1-3 tall pines (spruce trunk 9-11 high with a flat umbrella crown). Leaves that would stick out on their own are trimmed off.

4 Outpost: next to the Fort, added a lower second lookout deck at y 8 on stripped-spruce posts, with a rail, a ladder, a fence net up its east side and a log bridge to the Fort's mid platform. Also a hollow log crib tower (5 alternating courses of stripped oak and spruce, plank top, mangrove roots), a log scramble of crisscrossed beams in three courses, and 5 more boulders. The existing log pile, balance logs, sand pit, gravel/coarse-dirt play ground and the 1-wide water runnel are kept.

5 Paths: path corners are now rounded so they sweep instead of kinking, and the switchback was widened from 2 to 3 so every park path is 3 wide. Lamps stay every 9 blocks along the paths. The Cliff Walk railing is now two courses high (stripped-spruce posts every 4 with two spruce-fence rails). The two jutting overlook decks with north-facing benches were already there and are kept.

6 Terraces: both banks are rebuilt as curved amphitheatres whose tiers bow north toward the ends. Each tier front is a spruce-slab bench top on a calcite riser, half a block above the tier below, with smooth-sandstone half steps in the aisle. Calcite planters with grasses stand at both ends of each tier. The light-gray-concrete promenade with its lamps, benches and planters is kept.
skipped: Parkway lanes: in the cut and the tunnels the road stays 2 lanes each way (5 wide). The bore mouths are fixed at 5 wide, and at 0.5 blocks/m a lane with its line takes about 1 block. The 3+3 lanes run on the sweep and narrow at the cut.

Parkway route: the real road comes in further north across the whole W band, but with the portal and cut fixed, the only highway-scale curve that fits is one arc entering the west edge at about z 66-91. The north part of the old lot (z 30-60) is a planted verge, not road.
Terrace steps: kept at 3 tiers (y 7/8/9) plus the half-step bench fronts. A 4th full step would have moved the terrace heights and the lawn path, so I didn't add one.

Lighting: I didn't verify the no-spawn requirement. `mcd light` puts dark cells at 3,996, down from 4,612 in v1, but its source count (94) suggests it ignores the hidden `light` blocks, so that number doesn't show whether mobs can spawn. Dense planting also left fewer free cells beside paths, so lamp posts went from 89 to 77; spacing is still every 9.

Check findings I left alone: 5 orphan spruce slabs on the existing picnic tables and 6 'unsupported' sea lanterns, which are mounted under the tunnel ceiling slab. Both were in v1. The palette flags on the road markings and tunnel back wall are on purpose.
